relations.text: 2015年に助言事業を分離してPJTと統合
relations.text_en: Spun off its advisory businesses into PJT in 2015

source.label: Blackstone Infrastructure Strategies 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On October 1, 2015, Blackstone spun off its financial and strategic advisory services, restructuring and reorganization advisory services, and its Park Hill Group fund placement businesses, and combined these businesses with PJT Partners Inc.

companies.name: キャンバービュー・パートナーズ

source.label: PJT Partners 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Goodwill and Intangible Assets Goodwill recorded arose from the contribution and reorganization of former Parent's predecessor entities in 2007 immediately prior to former Parent's initial public offering ("IPO"), the acquisition of PJT Capital LP that occurred on October 1, 2015, the acquisition of CamberView Partners Holdings, LLC ("CamberView") that occurred on October 1, 2018 and the acquisition of deNovo Partners that occurred on October 1, 2024.
